Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Lambeeron's Seasonal Shane and Vanilla Shane Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portraits of Shane, since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84716693]Lambeeron[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9945]Shane the Fashion Enthusiast - Seasonal Outfits[/url] version and vanilla version (with default hoodie and no seasonals).

[size=4][b]This mod only includes the portrait. For the Seasonal Shane sprite, please go download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84716693]Lambeeron[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9945][u]CP Lambeeron's Shane the Fashion Enthusiast - Seasonal Outfits[/u][/url] mod.[/b][/size]

For people who don't like the seasonal outfits or don't want to install Lambeeron's Seasonal Shane mod, I made a vanilla version with the default hoodie and no seasonal outfits.

Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. 
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]


There are 3 versions. One is the Content Patcher version, Drag into Stardew Valley\Mods to install.

The other version (in the optional file) is replacement files for people who have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9945]CP Lambeeron's Shane the Fashion Enthusiast - Seasonal Outfits[/url] mod.
To install, find where you installed your [b]DCBurger's Portrait[/b] or [b]Shane the Fashion Enthusiast - Seasonal Outfits[/b] mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder).
Drag the "assets" folder from my zip into the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] DCBurger's High Res Portraits[/b] or [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Shane Seasonal Outfits[/b] folder to overwrite the folder in it to install.

The replacement version prevents assets from getting loaded two times, choose whichever version you prefer/which Ever version that works for you.


Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



The original art style belongs to DCBurger: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66555116]tryptan[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9945]Shane the Fashion Enthusiast[/url] mod and the amazing seasonal outfit design belongs to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84716693]Lambeeron[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.[url=https://ko-fi.com/orangepieuwu]
[/url]
